# Review - PR 274 @ c791c8f612de4cff46a9d4b4ed93f9577739a4d8

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: e94aa25476d20ec535da2997427c914f20bef166. Small additive change onto `main` (merge base `797c5e846c35ab970dac3b8cff5260c3347b1adf`): one new 193-line Lean module `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/ExpandedSpectator.lean`, its import in the QPBT root, and one audit record - 3 files, 277 insertions, no deletions.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/ExpandedSpectator.lean:81 - `psiHatAlicePair` is a verbatim duplicate of `ExtendedLineGame.pairState` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ExtendedLineGame.lean:342`, `reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor ψ (eprState (PauliRegister _)))`), and `aliceSpectatorShuffle` (:97) and `psiHat_eq_alicePair_tensor_epr` (:120) duplicate `aaBaRegrouping` and `reindexState_aaBaRegrouping_psiHat` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ExtendedLineGame/StateTransport.lean:43,62`), both already present at this PR's merge base; the PR adds a second, unconnected public description of the same `AA'|BA''` bipartition. Fix: reuse the existing declarations - hoist `pairState` and the two regroupings into an `Observables`-layer module (or state the new identities in `Combining`, below `StateTransport`) and derive the new complex-expectation lemmas from them, rather than redefining the pair state and its shuffle.
- [ ] F2 (prose; minor) audits/2026-09-07_expanded-spectator-273-refresh.md:8 - the Scope paragraph asserts "The complete 192-line `Observables/ExpandedSpectator.lean` module is unchanged, with Git blob `7d9afc63...`", but at the reviewed head the module is 193 lines with blob `ac8f1200a50eb5a4c421df06c5edfaf98a4b6ea5`; the same document's last Validation paragraph describes the `open Classical in` edit that changed it, so the record contradicts itself. Fix: restate the blob and line count for the published head, or scope the sentence explicitly to `b716c50c`.
- [ ] F3 (prose; minor) audits/2026-09-07_expanded-spectator-273-refresh.md:1 - the new audit has no YAML front matter, which `audits/2026-04-29_audit-document-format.md` ("Every audit should begin with YAML front matter") requires of new audit files via `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` section 5 item 3. Fix: add the minimal header at the top of the file - `title`, `date`, `purpose`, plus the quoted issue number 273 and pull-request number 274 in the fields that document names.

## Review

Checked at the published head, which equals the branch worktree HEAD.

Mathematics and proof integrity: the module's source locators are accurate - `eq:def-psihat` is at `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-372` and the two register partitions at 433-450 - and the six-register coordinates used by `aliceSpectatorShuffle` and `bobSpectatorShuffle` agree register by register with `SixReg`, `sixRegShuffle` and the four cases of `place` in `ExpandedDefs.lean:46-135`. `psiHatBobPair` reverses the strategy coordinates explicitly through `Equiv.prodComm`, so no symmetry of the strategy and no equality of the two player spaces is assumed, and `psiHat_expectation_AA'_BA''` / `psiHat_expectation_BB'_AB''` are exact identities of the full complex expectation for arbitrary (not necessarily Hermitian or positive) operators - a genuine strengthening over the Hermitian `stateQForm` transport already on main. No hypothesis trivializes a conclusion, no statement is weakened, and the private helper `inner_reindex_tensor_epr_one` carries the normalization through `eprState_norm` rather than assuming it. The module contains no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide`, and the six public declarations' axiom closures are exactly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (checked with `#print axioms` from a scratch file outside the worktree). `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/ExpandedSpectator.lean` elaborates with no error and no warning, confirming that the prior round's finding F1 at `44e6526e` (module-wide `open Classical` tripping `linter.style.openClassical`) is addressed at this head by the declaration-scoped `open Classical in` on lines 117 and 126; that was the only open finding in the earlier marked reviews. Exact-head CI is green on every context (`local-ci/summary`: all gating steps passed). No line exceeds the 100-character limit.

F1 is not a soundness problem; it is the reuse rule (reviewer persona, `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` section 5 item 7). `ExtendedLineGame.pairState` and the `aaBaRegrouping`/`abBbRegrouping` factorizations were already on `main` at the merge base and are used there to transport Born correlations for `lem:qld-4-7`; nothing in the branch consumes the new module, so merging it leaves two parallel public vocabularies for the same bipartition, differing gratuitously on the second partition (main maps both partitions onto one `pairState` using EPR symmetry, while the PR introduces a separate `psiHatBobPair` on `bob x alice`). I note the layering constraint that forces the concrete fix: `Observables` sits below `Combining`, so the shared definitions have to move down rather than be imported up. Naming is also slightly off the local pattern - main writes `place_..._mul_place_..._nonneg` and `stateQForm_place_AA'_mul_BA''`, the PR writes `place_AA'_mul_BA''`; I do not raise that separately, but it would resolve itself under the reuse fix.

Prose lane applies because the diff adds an audit record; blueprint TeX and `docs/paper-gaps` are untouched, no `\lean`/`\leanok`/`\uses` tag is added or changed, and the cited labels `def:expanded-state` and `def:symmetric-equivalents` do exist in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex`. The audit's mathematical content is accurate: the spectator pair does contribute its squared norm, the identities really are exact and hypothesis-free, and the claimed axiom closures match what I measured. F2 and F3 are defects in the record itself, not in the mathematics.

Not checked: a full `lake build` (the machine-wide serialized build was not taken; I relied on the green exact-head CI), the blueprint render, and the correctness of unchanged `main` modules that the new file depends on.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=CHANGES_REQUESTED)
